## What does this improve?

Describe the user problem and your change. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results. For visible changes, add a redacted
screenshot if helpful. Note any checks you could not run or remaining limitations.

## Before submitting

- [ ] The change is focused and includes relevant documentation updates.
- [ ] Tests or manual checks cover the affected behavior.
- [ ] No secrets, private data or generated output are included; any new third-party material has attribution.
